summary: Route canonical price and inventory events to PrestaShop through a dedicated idempotent worker consumer instead of advertising SDK-only writes.

impacts.evidence: Policies, account capabilities, offer mappings and receipts are resolved under the event organization/workspace scope.
No new personal data is persisted or emitted.
Sync policy admission now permits the already-defined provider-neutral prices entity for an executable runtime route; no endpoint shape changes.
Existing canonical pricing and inventory event types are consumed without envelope changes.
PriceWriter and InventoryWriter SDK interfaces are reused unchanged.
Existing sync_local_receipts and connector_entity_mappings tables are reused.
Account capability snapshots are rechecked and credentials remain inside callback-scoped runtime secrets.
prices.write and inventory.write remain write-sensitive manifest capabilities and require explicit account enablement.
Remote applied/duplicate outcomes are durably recorded in the existing local sync receipt ledger.
Dedicated consumer uses deterministic idempotency keys, receipt collision detection and Kafka retries/DLQ.
Outbound calls still use the existing PrestaShop host-mediated transport and its timeout/rate-limit policy.
Retryable connector errors remain on retry topics and malformed/non-retryable failures are dead-lettered.
Disable policies or account capabilities to stop writes; reverting the generated support row removes admission without migration.
Route conversion, capability admission and generated-contract checks cover the new path; live smoke remains documented separately.
